name: joplin-plugin-pasteit

scripts.dist: webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --config webpack.webview.js && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force

description: Paste It for Joplin: convert pasted content to Markdown with formatting options and tracking URL cleanup.
author: Jeremy Kao
